description: This file provides an implementation of all PSR-17 HTTP factory interfaces, including methods to create requests, responses, streams, URIs, uploaded files, and server requests, primarily by returning new object instances.

classes.name: HttpFactory
classes.description: Final class implementing all PSR-17 factory interfaces, providing methods to create HTTP message objects such as requests, responses, streams, uploaded files, and URIs.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates anUploadedFile object with the provided stream and optional metadata such as size, error status, filename, and media type.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream object from the provided string content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream object from a file, opening it with the specified mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream object from an existing resource.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a server request object for the specified HTTP method and URI, using server parameters.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a response object with the given status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a request object for the specified HTTP method and URI.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a URI object from the given URI string.
